intro.title: Find your level
intro.subtitle: Adaptive test: difficulty follows your answers. Level on the CEFR scale, score from 0 to 100.

points.questions: Twenty questions: ten on grammar and ten on general English.
points.duration: About seven minutes at a calm pace.
points.adaptive: Difficulty adapts to your answers — the test is adaptive.

intro.listeningHint: Six short listening tasks after the main questions. You can also take it later — a card will appear in Overview.

listening.title: Listening check
listening.intro: Listen to the recording before answering. Each clip can be played only twice — answer after listening.
listening.name: Listening
listening.saved: The level is saved in your profile and carries into the next session.

result.title: Level set
result.subtitle: The level appears in the summary before your first lesson and in your profile.
result.listeningHint: Listening is not checked yet: you can take it here or in Overview — the card waits on the start page.

levels.a1: Isolated words and simple phrases about yourself and everyday things.
levels.a2: Short phrases in familiar everyday situations.
levels.b1: Conversation on familiar topics, describing experience and plans.
levels.b2: Fluent discussion of work and abstract topics with arguments.
levels.c1: Fluent, flexible speech, complex texts and subtext.
levels.c2: Understanding of almost everything, including fine shades of meaning.
